leakage_policy: Synthetic schema names and example URIs only; no evaluation answers, qpair IDs, scores, or copied rules.

examples.lesson: Select a supplied datatype property when label, source kind, and domain/range are compatible.
Return no_match when supplied candidates do not express the same semantics.
An FK-like column should prefer a compatible object property over a literal property.
A non-FK identifier column may select an identifier datatype property when table context agrees.
